about: Poltava: a classical centre and green suburbs

Poltava is a cosy city with a classicist centre around the Round Square, low-rise streets, estates of apartment blocks and a large private sector. On the slopes above the Vorskla and in the suburbs there are many homesteads with big plots.
With such homesteads the question is often whether to reconstruct the old house or build a new one. We price both options, so the decision rests on an estimate rather than a hunch.

For houses on large plots the design also covers the space around: terrace, summer kitchen, entrance. For apartments in the centre — classical proportions with modern function; for new builds — well-thought-out storage. Design project from $30 per m² (minimum $2,500); packages are on the [interior design studio](/en/interior-design) page.

We renovate apartments and houses, from major renovation with new services to finishing. In the Poltava region we build aerated-block, brick, timber-frame and log houses; sloping plots above the Vorskla need a careful foundation and drainage design, which we settle before work starts.

Renovation is carried out by our salaried team: from $550 per m² for works and rough materials, with finishing materials, furniture and appliances priced separately per estimate. Scope, schedule and payment plan (50/50, 50/30/20 or in stages, from a 10% advance) are fixed in the contract; team travel is on individual terms. Architectural design from $12 per m², house shell from $600 per m², turnkey with finishing from $1,100 per m² — see [turnkey renovation](/en/turnkey-renovation) and [house construction](/en/house-construction).

Design and approvals run online; we travel for measurements and key stages on the schedule set in the contract, and the terms and costs of travel and team accommodation are individual. Between visits you get photo reports every 1–2 weeks, and an online camera on site 24/7 is available for an extra fee.
